notes.title: Update 6th December 2018
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone,

Hotfixes have been going well. There were a few bugs, as expected, with the last patch, but they should be mostly fixed.

Also, we now have a tutorial! Check it out!

So, between now and release I'll be inserting the art as I get it, playtesting and fixing, taking feedback and otherwise getting started on the first update.

Cheers,
Otis

notes.title: Blacksmith Pre-emptive Update
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone,

We're releasing the next patch a little early since I heard of at least a couple people with problems on the title screen. So better to release an unfinished build than to let that problem persist.

This patch will definitely feel a little incomplete, with a bunch of missing textures and some untested features in the late game.

So, what's new:
- Brand new graphics for the UI!
- A skill tree for learning Blacksmithing Recipes!!!
- Some improved graphics for the basic Armour sets and Handles!
- A whole heap of new Armour to go with the skill tree! (Untextured!)
- A reworking of the Shop. You can no longer run your own shop, but instead Sid also now sells everything in the game but at an increased price.
- More Sound Effects.
- Several fixes and improvements as always.
- If you are a returning player you may find your save doesn't work anymore. I'm sorry if that's the case, but you can be assured that there will be no more problems with that post version 1.0.

And what is going to be broken in this patch! Caution for:
- Some missing/bad textures in the UI, and some of the colours are wrong. We are still figuring this out and as always I am waiting for more assets from my artist.
- Almost all the new Armour is missing a texture. We will have those soon. All of the pre-existing weapons and armour should be fine.
- New features like the Skill Tree and Sid's Trade MAY be bugged, they are relatively untested, but should work for the most part.

I will be working to turn this into a finished build asap. If you see any bugs besides those in the list above, it's because I don't know about them! So please tell me.


So what's next?

- I will hotfix as new art assets are given to me and bugs are discovered, until this build is completely stable.
- The next build will have an Apprenticeship! This will be an optional tutorial at the start of the game. When you hit New Game you will be given the option to take on a 3 day Apprenticeship with the Legendary John Smith!
- Once all of that is stable, we will examine how much time we have between then and release, and see what we can do until then.
- Version 1.1 will release not long after full release, and we have a lot of plans for that.


So, look out for hot fixes and I hope to see you on the 11th of January for the full release. We also have a very special announcement coming on the 23rd of December.

So, keep your forges bright and strong as we hammer our way into 2019!

Cheers,
Otis and Maly

notes.title: Hotfix and Final Release Date!
notes.notes:
Hotfix today with a few minor fixes and improvements. Please send me your feedback and thoughts on the game, what should I prioritize improving? Is the tutorial clear? How could the UIs be improved?

Blacksmith 1.0 will be released on the 11th of January 2019! Until then, there will be hotfixes to address any bugs or issues but I won't be making an official update until that time.

What new to expect in Blacksmith 1.0.
- An extended ending sequence.
- New and improved sound effects, animations, sprites etc.
- Your feedback addressed.
- Anything else I have time for.

Until then, play some Blacksmith and have a say in the final product!

We have also committed to a few post-release updates. More news on that when appropriate.

ps Name your game EasyMode as in the trailer and you'll get 10 Steel, 1 Frozen Tear and 1 Phoenix Feather a day.

notes.title: The Music Update + Next Update is Blacksmith 1.0!
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone,

I'm proud to announce The Music Update for Blacksmith, with music from the very talented Aliki Lef.

What's new?
- Lots of original music that changes dynamically based your your gameplay!
- You can now finish the main story of the game!!!
- Several new Story Quests, Dungeons and Enemies.
- Tons of bug fixes as always.
- Send yourself into battle as Ironwell's most handsome Hero! (Must be unlocked through the Main Story)

There is a lot of new stuff and improvements. The game can now be called complete! Therefore the next update will be version 1.0. Until then I need as much data from the players as possible to make the game shiny for the final release.

More details about the Final Release and a new trailer to follow in the next few days. Expect hotfixes to address bugs, missing art assets and anything else that comes up (things that shouldn't effect your save game).

So I hope you enjoy the latest update and if you have any suggestions or bug reports, now is the time!

Cheers,
Otis

notes.title: The Sparks Update
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone,

It's been a few weeks since an update. I'm waiting for the music before I unlock the final scenes in the game and get ready for final release.

I have, however, received some new art. So this update includes more decorations in the Dungeons, sprites for Weapon Handles and a few basic fixes and tweaks.

Also, we've introduced a new Hero complete with their own Story, as a thank you for your patience bearing with us while we wait for the music. This is a pure homage to my favourite anime. It is unlocked after finishing Val's Story.

At present the game is very stable and playable. Once I get the music I can finish the Main Story and release an update which should be much more representative of the final product.

Until then, let those Sparks fly and see you in a couple weeks or so.

Cheers,
Otis

notes.title: Progress Update
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone,

I've just uploaded a build which deals with a lot of little bugs in the story and gameplay.

Right now what I'm doing is fixing the final cutscenes. I'm currently waiting for art and music assets before I upload that content. We're looking at having the first draft of the finished game by the end of August.

The main thing I want feedback on is the Farms/Food system. I'm happy that the player gets to do some farming, but I feel that actually it's quite tedious. I'm thinking of overhauling it with a much simpler system where you get 'ingredients' in the Dungeon, then Trade with the Farmer to cash in combinations of those ingredients for meals with permanent stat boosts. Or perhaps I'll just streamline the current system. Everyone's thoughts are appreciated on that.


There may still be a couple of instances of Hero Stats changing permantly after a cutscene or something similar. If you spot any instances like this, please let me know and I'll fix them promptly.

See you all later in August as Blacksmith approaches the finish line! Get your Heroes strong for the end!

Cheers,
Otis and Maly

notes.title: The Story Update 0.5
notes.notes:
There have been a huge amount of bug fixes and balance improvements since the last patches. Problems with Hero Stats and Abilities, the later stages of the Mines, chicken, dodgy Goblins. Those seem to be fixed now.

We also have a few new main story cutscenes. Nothing special just yet, but enough to keep you going until the next update.

I will continue to release updates for Blacksmith every 2 weeks at least with complete story chunks. If I or any of my fellow Blacksmiths find any more bugs, I will release hotfixes to address those.

If you're having problems equipping Heroes with Abilities because their stats are off, then I'm afraid you might have to start a new game. Alternatively, you can work around it by trying to make their stats no lower than 0. If you find any more instances of Heroes losing stats (usually when they are dismissed for a cutscene), please let me know.

Next update coming when it's ready. Until then you can meet the Wizard, find the Scrolls of John Smith, obtain the Golden Hearts of your favourite Heroes and get your guys strong for the next batch of content!

Cheers,
Otis and Maly

notes.title: The Silk Road Update is here!
notes.notes:
The Silk Road Update is here!

What's new?
- You can now sell your goods on display racks and open your own shop!
- You can name 3 Champions to gain more Reagents and help them earn Coin.
- A more detailed Daily Report at the end of each day.
- Lots of balancing and bug fixing.
- Sound options.
- More Mine Nodes and Farm Plots.
- Global dodge chance has been reduced by request.

The next update will be the Forge your Story Update. This will focus on and expand the main story for the player. I hope that by mid-July, the game is basically feature and story complete, then we will spend July filling the gaps, doing the art and improving the balance etc. Music should be on its way soon too!

I will try to stick to the bi-weekly update, but the priority now is just getting it done. The next one should be mid-July at the latest but we'll see.

If there are any problems with the new features, please let me know and I'll get right on them.

Cheers,
Otis and Maly

notes.title: The Silk Road Update is on its way.
notes.notes:
The latest update for Blacksmith is having a few delays.

With the Champions and the Shop Keeping features there are a lot of bugs. I expect to have this update fully ready and balanced by the end of next week, which seems likely.

So, instead of making a buggy release now, the next update will be released when it's ready.

We have Farms, Mines, Shop Keeping and a whole bunch of new stuff since the game entered Early Access. These need to be properly balanced and tied together and then we'll focus on the main story. We've also started the process of having some proper music!

Hasta pronto!

Cheers,
Otis and Maly

notes.title: The Mines Update is here!
notes.notes:
Greetings, fellow Blacksmiths.

The Mines Update is here!

So what's new?

- As promised, the mines feature has now been implemented. Oof has been joined by Orville, Silvio and Willy to go deeper into the mines, allowing the player to control the amount of Ore they get as well as adding another layer of progression and customization to the game.
- The ancient Dwarven Kingdom has been uncovered beneath Ironwell! Join new Heroes Minnie and Ironbeard in their quest to restore the Dwarfs to their former glory and find love in Ironwell. That makes 7 Dwarfs.
- New weapons and food to go with them.

Other new and exciting features have also been added.
- Repair! Now, instead of having to make a new piece of gear each time, you can repair it.
- Fast Forward! People were asking for faster combat, so now you can speed it up.
- You can now level up each Hero once after finishing their Story.
- Various other improvements and minor bug fixes.

There are still a few placeholder textures and balancing issues there in the late game, but those should be addressed with hotfixes over the next few days. New video for the Store Page coming later tonight.

The next update will be The Silk Road, which will introduce a shop keeping feature. The description on the Store Page should now outline our plans between the end of May and transition to full release in August.

So, grab your Pickaxe and get mining! I'll see you all on the 7th of June for the Silk Road Update!

Cheers,
Otis and Maly

notes.title: Announcing The Mines Update
notes.notes:
Here are the plans for The Mines Update, planned for the 24th of May, 2018, as part of our 14 day update cycle.

- Much like the new Farms feature, we will be adding a Mines feature which will make it possible to control the type and amount of Ore you get. There will be a progression system to this and it should be fun.
- A couple new Heroes and Townsfolk, mostly dwarf themed, with dialogues and scenes to go with them.
- A couple new dungeons and enemies to go with the Mines.
- New Weapons, Armour, Tools and Food.

If there are any bugs reported I will likely do hotfixes between now and then. At the moment the game is mostly bug free unless you tell me otherwise.

So, keep your pickaxes sharp for the coming content!

Cheers,
Otis and Maly

notes.title: The Farms Update
notes.notes:
The Farms Update is here!

Blacksmith has a major update every 2 weeks, so stay tuned for news on the next one.

- As promised, the Farms update introduces a whole new farming mechanic. Choose your crops, choose what meals you want to make from them, and then eat them at the Inn or feed them to Heroes on before Dungeons for big bonuses. To access this content, talk to Lord Alphonse, and then build the new buildings from Mason Phil. Good food will be necessary to beat the later dungeons!

- New Heroes and Townsfolk added with full stories and trade functionality.
- New Dungeons and Enemies.
- Lots of little fixes and features.
- So much new food! Many thanks to my artist and girlfriend Maly.

I hope you all enjoy this new update. There's at least a couple hours of new content there for returning players and a much meatier and 'smoothier' ride for new players.

There have been no hotfixes recently because there have been no new bugs reported! There are hotfixes planned in the next few days.

So have a cup of tea, grab your hammer, and come on down to Ironwell!

Cheers,
Otis and Maly

notes.title: The Farms Update Coming Soon
notes.notes:
The next official Update for Blacksmith will be The Farms Update.

- A whole new farming system. You will be able to Trade with Farmer Eric to gain access to a very simple farming game. Once you have the right seeds and blueprints, you will be able to plant Crops on a small grid. These crops will produce meals, which provide bonuses for the Heroes and Townsfolk.

For example: A Potato will produce the meal ‘Potato’, which heals Heroes each day and can be bought by the Blacksmith at the Inn. Start growing a Leak, and now you will have access to ‘Leak and Potato Soup’, which is far more powerful.

I’m really excited about this new feature. This is going to be in place of an XP based levelling system.

- With all this new food, the Heroes of Ironwell will be much stronger, so we’re adding a couple more Dungeons and Enemies to the mix.
- Also a couple new Buildings, Heroes, Townsfolk and Weapons each, with a couple dialogues and cutscenes to go with them.
- As always I will be addressing bugs and fixes as I see them and responding to community input.


Hotfix today includes:
- Bugs, balancing and improvements.
- A new Book telling the story of the Blacksmith.
- Clients will now automatically Chat when you talk to them.
- An explanation for in-game hangovers.


So forge on, Blacksmith! Keep your weapons sharp for the incoming new content!

Cheers,
Otis and Maly

notes.title: The Quench Update!
notes.notes:
The Quench Update is here!

The Quench is the first official update for Blacksmith. The aim of this update is to bring Blacksmith to a stable standard so that we can add more content, addressing any bugs and suggestions raised by the community.

As planned, new features for The Quench Update include:
	- A Quenching feature for the crafting system.
	- Many basic belated fixes and improvements.
	- Multiple saves feature added.
	- New voices added.
	- Tons of balance and bug fixes.

That’s not all. We also have:
	- A ‘Story Book’ feature. Each Hero in the game now has a book about them. Once unlocked and purchased from the Librarian, you can get hints about how to proceed the Hero's story. This should allow people to quickly access all the hidden content in the game, if that’s what they want.
	- Loads more Tutorials! The Bookshelf has been tidied and filled with video tutorials.
	- New scenes for a few characters. Why not buy some books from Tori and find out who?
	- New difficulty setting for Dungeons.
	- Some fairly big changes to Combat.
	- You can now buy Buildings to increase the amount of Heroes per Dungeon.
	- A zoom out function by request, for players with larger screens.
	- Maly has been hard at work ironing out all the kinks in the sprites.
	- Lots more bug fixes and balances since the last hotfix.

The next official update is planned for 10th of May 2018, two weeks from now. There will be hotfixes over the next few days at least. In a couple days I will be releasing more information about the next update so stay tuned.

’Til next time!

Cheers,
Otis and Maly

notes.title: Hotfix and Changes to Combat
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

First of all hotfixes:
- There was a bug in a scene with Kage. Most of you probably didn't find it unless your Akira was amazingly fast. That's fixed.
- Fixed an issue where the game would crash on saving. Thank Goda for that.
- A few UI fixes to do with overlapping.
- A book explaining the Hero Stats in your Bookshelf.
- New voices for Eric, Fleur, Inuenda.

Many thanks to the community for helping me find and identify the bugs.


Changes to Combat:
Big experimental changes that are mostly untested.

1. Heroes and Enemies in positions 2 and 3 will now do less damage. 75% damage for position 2 and 50% for position 3. This does not effect Abilities and is calculated after the armour reduction.
2. Some abilities, including the Frostbolt, Heal and Bow and Arrow, now do damage based on the Weapon the Hero is carrying.
3. Ability Quantities are now increased by the Hero's Intelligence.

With these changes, Dungeons should be a little less one sided either way. If you still want Akira to deal crazy damage per second, you have to risk him up front. Despite the damage nerfs, the more powerful and numerous Abilities should make for faster combat with a greater feeling of agency. With Intelligence boosting Ability Quantity, 'Shieldbearer' or 'Archer' builds become viable. Try Kage with Dex boosting gear and Arrows. Try Chris with Int boosting gear and a Shield.


Make sure to Chat with the Heroes and Townsfolk of Ironwell for story content!

The Quench is still on the way for the 26th of April 2018. Most of it is released already with these hotfixes, but some bugs we can't leave unsquashed!

Cheers,
Otis and Maly

notes.title: Ongoing Hotfixes and Next Update
notes.notes:
First of all Hotfixes. There have been ongoing hotfixes over the last few days since release. If you encountered a bug in your first few days, it's likely that's gone now. For example Headbands no longer make Heroes bald, no more getting stuck in the floor at the Inn and the audio has been fixed for the 'dream sequence'. Lots of little things as well.

As a result of needing to upload hotfixes, there's a preview of the new Quenching feature in the latest build. I'm very keen for feedback on this feature.

The Quench Update is planned and on schedule for the 26th of April 2018. This will include video tutorials at the start of the game, more voices and a few UI upgrades including a better way to access Heroes and their Abilities during Combat. If possible I would also like to add the ability to use multiple save files. There are some other things planned but this is the bare minimum I hope to achieve. More information will come with the update.

I hope you're all enjoying life in your new Forge. Make sure to Chat to customers and remember the Bookshelf, the Innkeeper and me, the Developer, are all here to help you if needed!
